phase: Phase 3 — Build Beautiful Websites with CSS
description: Create movement using transitions and keyframes.
definition: Transitions and keyframes create changes over time.
rule: A transition responds to a changed property; keyframes define an animation sequence.
tip: Opacity and transform are useful properties for simple interface motion.
caution: Respect reduced motion preferences and avoid unnecessary movement.
exercise: Animate a card entrance with a short fade and upward movement.
